item.title: Tankers beware: NBA fines Utah Jazz $500,000 and Indiana Pacers $100,000 for sitting players
item.description: The Utah Jazz appeared to find a loophole in the NBA’s player participation policy, but the league sent a message Thursday by hitting them with a $500,000 fine.

item.title: LeBron James becomes the oldest player in NBA history to have a triple-double
item.description: LeBron James became the oldest player in NBA history to have a triple-double, accomplishing the feat for the Los Angeles Lakers on Thursday night against the Dallas Mavericks.

item.title: Asking Eric: Counseling is an option
item.description: Dear Eric: My significant other and I have been together 10 years now. Lately, since he reconnected with childhood friends, we stopped doing things together. We stopped doing things as a family (we have children). He is with them all of the time. I expressed how I felt and gave suggestions on how we can balance and improve, but he only gets defensive. I feel like I should walk away at this point. He is 48, I’m 37. How should I deal with this?
